Definition: akin to the base of G5147; to crowd (literally or figuratively):--afflict, narrow, throng, suffer tribulation, trouble.
BiblicalUsage: thlíbō is the word the Bible uses when it means to press, to crowd, to afflict. In Matthew 7:14, Because strait is the gate, and it appears again in Mark 3:9.
TheologicalSignificance: A strait gate and a narrow way tell me plainly that following Jesus was never promised to be roomy or easy.
